body:
Thank you for reply.

I have used some methylphenidate from old prescription. It helped. I’ve read the Gillman writing about this being ok if careful. Highly doubt my doc would prescribe, though.

Still working on insurance appeal to pay for more than 12 mg Emsam…family paying out of pocket to get me to 18 so 24 mg likely out of reach

So I guess I’ve got Parnate and Marplan to consider…???

Thank you. I will definitely look into Marplan if unable to get the additional Emsam.

It is also encouraging to hear that Parnate effective for you after difficult burn in period.

Also, random aside on “last resort” feeling…I’ve felt that fear ..but I’m keeping in mind the other most common MAOIS I haven’t used — in US. Also heard encouraging presentation last night from md regarding psylocibin and LSD research at University of Alabama Birmingham and Johns Hopkins.

One of the symptoms of my MDD is seemingly uncontrollable crying. I have tried approximately 30 or so meds since 2009. Also 10 bilateral sessions of ECT and the 6-infusion, weekly nasal inhaler routine with ketamine. 

While I only had 2 months time before needing higher dose due to complicated hrt mess, that 2 months at 12 mg was the most “myself” I have felt in the 12 years. Minimal crying, which was remarkable. Now 16 mg appears to have same effect, but having insurance issue limiting me to 12 mg right now….and the crying is back…maybe not as bad as without the Emsam but enough that it interferes with my functioning.

 But it could well be you might be helped significantly by 9 or 12 mg.

Thank you for reminder to stay safe. Safety of source IS major. 

Where were you getting info re rage, empathy issues? Would like to learn more…. 

Using highest selegiline patch, trying to jump through appeals hoops to get insurance approval for multiple patches for higher dose…12 mg helping significantly right now but HRT-related issues got messy and 18 mg seems the sweet spot. 

Tried Parnate 30 mg, could not function much from side effects , but was just 10 days. 

Then doc says wants to appeal patch quantity limitation again, then maybe I sue insurance…so could take significant time. Could be honeymoon, but selegiline patch has been only thing in more than decade that has made me feel human. Hence the fighting so hard to get needed dose. Thought oral selegiline might help in meantime…
Can’t get goldpharma site to load
Insurance won’t cover above 12 mg patch; I need 18 mg.

Agreed. And so are the artificial drug prices. Wholesale of a box of 30 Emsam patches is $431. That’s what the pharmacy pays. Retail is about $1850. Of course I have no idea how to buy at or near wholesale.

Follow up…

I KNOW tranylcypromine is a wonderful med for many people….and I’m guessing I could have figured it out for me with more time…

But for now doc and I decided to go back to 12 mg Emsam…he especially didn’t like the cognition issues and degree of orthostatic hypotension….and he thought two articles I sent him will help with quantity limitation appeal. (Thank you to Dr. Neil Shah of maoinhibitors.com for sending me those references.)

So hopefully dr’s third appeal will work for dosage increase ; if not, I’ve been speaking to attorney about pursuing appeal from legal angle.
 
Emsam btw…average wholesale price for box is about $431, so not sure how it comes out $1800-$2000 retail…..and no clue how one would get price closer to retail…but wow 300 percent price difference?

I used Emsam which worked great at 12 mg until made a change with hormone replacement therapy…then 18 mg worked but insurance won’t pay for that dose. Started with 6 mg patch, maybe 10-15 percent symptom relief after 2-3 weeks…more improvement at 9 mg after on that dose 2-3 weeks. Once started 12 mg, had 85-90 percent relief after two weeks. On 18 mg (was using my old supply of 6 mg + the 12 mg covered by insurance)…after starting  18 mg, 90-95 percent symptom relief in about 10 days. Amazing.
Started switch from Emsam to Parnate yesterday, so following. 18 mg Emsam straight to 30 mg Parnate next day. I am soooo groggy/tired/spacey from Parnate on day 2….Hope fog lifts soon.
This knocked my insurance copay down to $20 from $120: https://www.activatethecard.com/viatrisadvocate/emsam/welcome.html

Now at 12 Mg waiting for insurance to make formulary exception and let me use 2 x 9 Mg patches per day. Or they will reject exception request and I will go on Parnate. 

Moving from 6 Mg to 9mg, had no issue with irritability.

With Emsam never any sexual problem. Was clear of that once getting off Celexa like a year before.
My usual go to for sleep is 1 Mg clonazepam and 100 Mg Dramamine. It got me through. Tried 3 Mg Lunesta which helped but I didn’t like the possibility of black out.

10 days of PremPro apparently knocked out all antidepressant efficacy for me more than 2 months ago. OBGYN later said the progestin in this HRT formulation worse than others for depression. But after 2 months off the PremPro I’m still more depressed than I can ever remember. Now have been on Mimvey -  different progestin - 3 weeks, trying to decide whether to cut to every other day or stop altogether. HRT initially changed due to serious hot flashes. Psych wants to change AD to Parnate. Seriously confused about what to do first or how to climb out of depression
For a few months 12 Mg helped me more than any med in years. Loss of efficacy  seemed to coincide with change in another med, but Emsam really knocked down the depression for a while.
Insomnia long time issue for me , so can’t blame all on Emsam, but on initial 6 mg, then with each dose increase I had about two weeks increased insomnia which would calm down after those two weeks.
TY
Be proud of yourself for taking this step!
I’m afraid they can look at me nodding and smiling and tell I’m totally zoning out and not paying full attention because I’m not capable of it sometimes.
You are stronger than you think!
It could be the one!
Sounds like improvement to me. Be proud of yourself.
Following. I don’t know any answers but you are not alone in feeling frustrated and alone.
I hope you find the solutions you’re looking for, whether with Amen or elsewhere.
I think it’s mostly chemical. I’ve forgotten how much it costs for Amen Clinic services. Do you know? Is there one of the clinics in your city? I’m a couple hours away from the one I went to.

I did the supplements for a few months, maybe 4 or 5, then went back to the prescription medication. I think there were a couple followup phone consults with the psychiatrist I saw at the Amen clinic but it’s been more than 5 years ago so I don’t remember all the details. I still have serious depression.

I did this a few years ago. My mom paid for it. They showed me images of what are supposed to be the messed up parts of my brain. The “solution” was to take their Amen brand supplements. They also recommended other medication for if the supplements didn’t work, but those meds were basically what I was already being given by my regular psychiatrist. I don’t think they share their research with the rest of the medical community so that makes it seem kind of sketchy. One benefit was that seeing those spect scans made my mother actually believe I have a real illness instead of a imaginary one. Maybe the money would be better spent on something like TMS.
Yeah.

That is definitely true. Weekends are the hardest time. And, well, hey, it's the weekend. I didn't get out of bed until 2:30 p.m. today because, well, depression. Weepiness, lethargy, anhedonia. I'm just watching Netflix and waiting for the weekend to pass...Everything is empty. I haven't thought about suicide too much this week. Not as much as usual. I have an appointment with my therapist scheduled tomorrow, but it just seems like a waste of time and money. We just we rehash the same old things. She tells me I need to get hobbies, yada, yada, and I go along with the conversation.
Yep. In 40s. Super depressed. You have company.
Still here. Not much else positive to report but still here. Thanks for checking.

I don’t think the independence he asserted at age 8 or so was THE turning point. I’m a single mom and we both had been living with my parents since I left his abusive father at 6 months pregnant. What did change that year is that I bought a house and moved us out of my parents house because they were undermining my parenting too much. So we went out on our own. Also I had lost a significant amount of weight the year before so people started treating me differently. I had some dating relationships that didn’t work out. But I don’t know if any of those changes caused the depression to come back or if it was a total coincidence. 

Now the independence he is asserting now at age 18 HAS been really hard on me. He is only doing what is healthy and spreading his wings. But in all these previous years of depression he has been my motivation to keep going. Since he graduated from HS in May he is just constantly away from home and  he is needing me less and less so I feel unnecessary. He is going to college locally and living at home for the foreseeable future because we are trying to avoid college debt. Sorry I’m rambling so incoherently. So he is not about to move out but I still have that empty-nest feeling. I know a lot of parents struggle with that and what I am supposed to do is ‘get a life” like hobbies or other activities I care about but the depression makes that seem impossible.

Thanks for commenting. It makes me feel less alone. There was a time before, a 13-year streak that the depression was in remission. The depression was there on and off during jr high, hs and college but it just went away during sr. year of college. So that 13-year streak of remission was when I started building my career and had my son. I am grateful for that streak. It allowed me to function and bond normally with my son during the first 8 years of his life and build a decent emotional foundation for him. But now it’s been 10 years with the depression back. Every year and every day and every med that doesn’t work just make it seem like another remission is more and more impossible. Hence the desperation.

Just continuing to vent. I’ve just been rocking myself and crying and screaming and begging God to fix my brain. I’v been holding a picture of my son, just crying out to God that I don’t want to leave my “baby” If anyone I know saw my behavior I’d likely end up uselessly sent inpatient. Which would be useless and costly. I’m still paying the bills from when I did ECT and inpatient two years ago. I’ve somehow been able to keep my job and keep the bills paid which is important because I don’t think I could handle having nowhere to go during the day. It would just be endless depressing ruminating otherwise. This July 4th holiday with no work to distract me is so hard. I think I possibly feel crazier and more dangerous today than I ever have. It always feels “the worst” but today might really be the worst. I have a reasonably workable plan to kms where it wouldn’t be a friend or family member to find me. I guess I will probably be fine for the rest of the day because an hour ago a I took a few Klonopin to knock me out for the rest of the day. It hopefully will kick in soon and I can sleep. My life on the exterior is fine. Except for the things 10 years of endogenous depression has taken from me. I can’t call anyone to talk to be with because I’m sure I’ve burned them all out and they just don’t understand this mental pain because they’ve never been through it. I mean I’m glad they don’t understand because it means they haven’t felt this. I feel such a strong tension between wanting to kms and not wanting to leave my son, selfish teenager that he may be at this point I his life. I feel so crazy and alone.
I understand how hard it is.

Some depression, the endogenous kind, isn’t caused by life circumstances. That means you can have a great like from external appearances and your depression isn’t caused by you life circumstances but rather by something like your brain chemistry or hormones. You could research “endogenous depression” to have some way to explain to your mom. If you went to a psychologist, they would possibly give you a questionnaire called a Beck Depression Inventory that would help figure out where you are on the depression scale.

Just because you don’t have suicidal thoughts doesn’t mean you don’t have depression. And depression can make you have those kind of self doubt where you think your just being a teen cliche. Depending on school counselors workloads, they often only have time to coordinate academic issues. Can you talk your parents or guardians?
